# Description

Report of the creation of Seurat objects from filtered count matrices generated by either CellBender or CellRanger.

## RMarkdown setup

```{r setup, include=TRUE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,

  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4,
  dpi = 150
)

set.seed(params$seed)

```


## Reading table with sample metadata

```{r read_sample_table, echo = TRUE}

sample_table <- read.table(
  file = params$sample_table,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("Sample table loaded with", nrow(sample_table), "rows and", ncol(sample_table), "columns.\n")

# Basic checks on required columns

required_cols <- c(params$sample_id_col, params$sample_path_col)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(sample_table))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("The following required columns are missing from the sample table: ",
  paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# Show the first few rows

head(sample_table)

```

## Processing samples

```{r create_seurat_objects, echo=TRUE}

dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Column names from params
sample_id_col   <- params$sample_id_col
sample_path_col <- params$sample_path_col
metadata_cols   <- params$metadata_cols
input_type_col  <- params$input_type_col

# Basic sanity checks on column names
if (is.null(sample_id_col) || !nzchar(sample_id_col)) {
  stop("params$sample_id_col is empty or NULL. Please set it to the sample ID column name.")
}
if (is.null(sample_path_col) || !nzchar(sample_path_col)) {
  stop("params$sample_path_col is empty or NULL. Please set it to the counts path column name.")
}

# Check that required columns exist in the sample table
st_cols <- colnames(sample_table)
cat("Columns in sample_table:\n")
print(st_cols)

if (!sample_id_col %in% st_cols) {
  stop("sample_id_col '", sample_id_col, "' not found in sample_table columns.")
}
if (!sample_path_col %in% st_cols) {
  stop("sample_path_col '", sample_path_col, "' not found in sample_table columns.")
}

# Check metadata columns (optional)
if (!is.null(metadata_cols) && length(metadata_cols) > 0) {
  missing_meta <- setdiff(metadata_cols, st_cols)
  if (length(missing_meta) > 0) {
    warning("The following metadata columns are missing in sample_table and will be ignored: ",
            paste(missing_meta, collapse = ", "))
    metadata_cols <- intersect(metadata_cols, st_cols)
  }
} else {
  metadata_cols <- character(0)
}

seurat_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sample_table))) {

  row_i <- sample_table[i, , drop = FALSE]

  # Extract sample ID and counts path
  sample_id <- as.character(row_i[[sample_id_col]])
  if (length(sample_id) != 1L || is.na(sample_id) || !nzchar(sample_id)) {
    stop("Invalid sample_id in row ", i, ". Got: ", paste(sample_id, collapse = ", "))
  }

  counts_path_raw <- as.character(row_i[[sample_path_col]])
  if (length(counts_path_raw) != 1L || is.na(counts_path_raw) || !nzchar(counts_path_raw)) {
    stop("Invalid sample path in row ", i, " for sample '", sample_id,
         "'. Got: ", paste(counts_path_raw, collapse = ", "))
  }

  counts_full_path <- resolve_path(params$base_dir, counts_path_raw)

  # Determine input type for this sample
  input_type_i <- params$input_type
  if (!is.null(input_type_col) && nzchar(input_type_col)) {
    if (!input_type_col %in% st_cols) {
      stop("input_type_col '", input_type_col, "' not found in sample_table columns.")
    }
    # If that cell is non-empty, override the global input_type
    it_val <- as.character(row_i[[input_type_col]])
    if (length(it_val) == 1L && nzchar(it_val)) {
      input_type_i <- it_val
    }
  }

  cat("\nProcessing sample:", sample_id, "\n")
  cat("  Counts path:", counts_full_path, "\n")
  cat("  Input type :", input_type_i, "\n")

  # Load counts
  counts_mat <- load_counts(counts_full_path, input_type_i)

  # Create Seurat object
  srt <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts_mat,
    min.cells = params$min_cells,
    min.features = params$min_features,
    project = sample_id
  )

  # Add sample-level metadata
  srt <- add_sample_metadata(
    obj = srt,
    metadata_row = row_i,
    sample_id_col = sample_id_col,
    metadata_cols = metadata_cols
  )

  # Compute mitochondrial percentage
  srt <- compute_percent_mito(
    obj = srt,
    mito_genes = params$mito_genes,
    mito_species = params$mito_species,
    mito_colname = params$mito_colname
  )

  # Store in list
  seurat_list[[sample_id]] <- srt

  # Save individual Seurat object
  out_file <- file.path(params$output_dir, paste0(sample_id, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(object = srt, file = out_file)
  cat("  Saved:", out_file, "\n")

  # Basic summary
  cat("  Dimensions (features x cells):\n")
  print(dim(srt))
}

if (isTRUE(params$save_list)) {
  list_file <- file.path(params$output_dir, "seurat_objects_by_sample.rds")
  saveRDS(seurat_list, file = list_file)
  cat("Saved list of Seurat objects to:", list_file, "\n")
}

```
